observations: Photo 0 shows three stacked Dell Precision 5820 towers. The front panel has 'Precision 5820' printed on the lower bezel, and the Dell logo is visible. The top unit has a DVD drive and a diamond-patterned front grille.

Photo 1 shows a tall stack of at least 7 identical Dell Precision 5820 towers, all with the same front design and Dell logo. The stack is in an outdoor or semi-outdoor market setting with people and boxes around.

Photo 2 shows the rear panels of a stack of at least 6 towers. The rear has multiple drive bays, power connectors, and I/O ports including USB, Ethernet, and video outputs. The chassis is silver with black side panels. The Dell logo is not visible on the rear, but the design matches the front view.
All units appear to be identical models, suggesting they are part of a bulk lot. The condition looks used, with some dust and wear. No internal components are visible.
